caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a round top and a reddish-brown finish. The table features a central drawer with a decorative brass handle. The front apron below the drawer is scalloped. The table stands on four turned legs, which are connected near the base by box stretchers that provide stability. The wood grain is visible, and the composition is centered on a plain, light beige background. The artist's name, "FRANCES LICHTEN," is written in small blue letters beneath the table on the right side. There are minor brownish stains or spots scattered across the background.
title: Pa. German Table
